HEADER.TITLE: Welcome to Limpicii!
HEADER.SUBTITLE: Discover our outdoor activities
ABOUT.PARAGRAPH_ONE: In Brașov, Limpicii brings children together through movement and experiences in nature. From swimming, tennis and gymnastics to skiing, skating and hiking, every activity is a chance to discover something new and spend time as a team.
ABOUT.PARAGRAPH_TWO: Here, every achievement is shared, friendships grow naturally, and every outing adds a new story. Limpicii — always a team!
ABOUT.IMAGE_ALT: Limpicii club members together on a tennis court
ABOUT.CAPTION: Always a team.
FACILITY.TITLE: Our sports facility in Hălchiu
FACILITY.DESCRIPTION: In Hălchiu, we have a welcoming sports facility with three tennis courts, two changing rooms with showers and restrooms, and a stand for spectators.
FACILITY.COURTS_DESCRIPTION: Three tennis courts for practice and playing together.
FACILITY.LOCKER_ROOMS_DESCRIPTION: Two comfortable changing rooms for athletes.
FACILITY.SHOWERS_DESCRIPTION: Facilities to help athletes freshen up after practice.
FACILITY.GRANDSTAND_DESCRIPTION: A place for family and friends to cheer on the team.
